about: Frozen holdout for the paired leg of the RFD4 quality grade (perf/rfd4/quality.py paired). These seeds are run once, to confirm a decision already made on development seeds, never to make one; quality.py refuses any case on them unless --allow-holdout is passed. Frozen 2026-10-24 before any design was generated on them; no fair cell, grade or bet uses 7000-7150. Method: Magnus Bauer, notes/validation/PROTOCOL-v2.md (rfd4-experimental @ 7fbfc2704).
